# Plan To Stand event in Democracy Week

**Published: 19th September 2025**

Time is ticking towards Jersey’s next major election on Sunday 7 June 2026 and you can go from ‘curious’ to candidate with Vote.je’s breakfast event on Thursday 25 September.

Anyone thinking about standing for election to become a States Member won’t want to miss this event. People who have attended a previous candidate event are very welcome to come along.

Join us and take the next step towards your election campaign:

- Make new connections
- Get practical advice from officials
- Be one of the first to get a copy of Vote.je’s _Essential Guide for Election Candidates_

The doors to the States building will be open from 7:30am for a 7:45am start, so you can grab a coffee and network with politicians and parliamentary staff.

**Panel line-up and special guests:**

- Connétable of St. Martin, Karen Shenton-Stone
- Deputy Hilary Jeune (St. John, St. Lawrence and Trinity)
- Deputy Sam Mézec (St. Helier South)
- Deputy David Warr (St. Helier South)
- Greffier of the States, Lisa Hart
- Chair of the Jersey Electoral Authority, Michael Marett-Crosby

Book your free ticket on the **[Vote.je Eventbrite page](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/plan-to-stand-for-election-in-2026-tickets-1468957755189?utm-campaign=social&utm-content=attendeeshare&utm-medium=discovery&utm-term=listing&utm-source=cp&aff=ebdsshcopyurl "Vote.je eventbrite")**.
